acceptance: The two accepted UIR-04A paths are the only writes and their Revision 165 baselines remain exact before dispatch.
An exact executable gate requires one exact UnifiedSourceIndexJobRuntime; every coherent inert gate requires runtime None and retains no runtime authority.
build_inert_cooperative_index_job_pump accepts only exact disabled or read_only config and returns a stopped content-free pump without constructing a store, provider, scope or live capability.
Inert wakeup rejects before runtime lookup or dependency use; executable wakeup preserves the accepted one-acquire one-run_next bound, concurrency, draining and JobStore authority.
The original eleven UIR-04A semantic nodes plus nine UIR-04B tests, focused and dependency corridors, static checks, central validators, independent QA and Deep-Sol pass on one frozen candidate.

correction_budget.on_repeat: release_blocked_reflect_and_continue_another_dependency_ready_product route without helper, third path, App binding or control-plane expansion

forbidden: third writer path, App edit, caller inventory edit, new helper layer, queue, scheduler, registry, store or durable authority
inert pump retaining or receiving a runtime, provider, store, scope, request, lease, cursor or live capability
builder acceptance of shadow, canary, active, degraded or rollback config
environment, file, Path, SQLite, provider, adapter, JobStore, socket, subprocess, thread, task, process or network action on import, construction or inert wakeup
loop, retry, pending wakeup, run_to_completion, register, cancel, lease release or hard-cancellation claim
raw exception, identifier, path, config value or dependency content; live, expensive test, stage, commit, push or deploy
hostile_matrix: Exact and subclassed runtime, config and state; executable gate plus None; inert gate plus supplied runtime; incoherent mode, enabled, generation and policy.
Direct constructor with disabled, read_only, degraded, rollback and non-running shadow, canary or active gates uses None and executes zero dependency steps.
Builder accepts exact disabled and read_only only; shadow, canary, active, degraded, rollback, wrong types and subclasses fail fixed content-free.
Disabled output has no generation, scope or provider; read_only output has only the captured generation, empty scopes/providers, stopped policy and no prompt or live authority.
Mutation before, during and after capture cannot turn an inert pump executable or redirect generation; failed construction returns no partially usable pump.
Private-marker Exception and BaseException from config access or typed-state construction become fresh allowlisted errors from None.
Duplicate and reentrant wakeup, concurrent close and dependency failures preserve the UIR-04A one-step and draining state machine.
Bomb environment, open, Path, SQLite, provider, store, adapter, socket, subprocess, Thread, multiprocessing and asyncio task creation on import, builder, constructor and inert wakeup.
invariants: Constructor validates and captures one coherent config/state gate before runtime admission; it retains neither config nor state.
Enabled means coherent shadow, canary or active plus WorkerPolicy.RUNNING; only that case accepts exact UnifiedSourceIndexJobRuntime.
Every coherent non-enabled gate accepts only None; supplying a runtime to an inert gate or None to an executable gate fails before a pump is returned.
The public inert builder accepts only exact disabled or read_only config and synthesizes one exact stopped RuntimeStateRecord with empty scopes and providers and live_activation_authorized false.
Disabled state uses no generation and disabled core health; read_only uses the exact selected generation and ready core health without provider capability.
Lifecycle rejection precedence remains closed then busy then inert; inert is decided before any runtime lookup or method call.
Executable wakeup, error, snapshot, close and draining semantics remain byte-for-contract compatible with accepted UIR-04A except for the intentional runtime admission and builder export changes.
JobStore remains the sole durable lease, cursor, attempt, retry, terminal and restart authority; no App or live activation is introduced.

public_contract.constructor: CooperativeIndexJobPump(runtime: UnifiedSourceIndexJobRuntime | None, config: UnifiedSourceIndexRuntimeConfig, state: RuntimeStateRecord)
public_contract.runtime_admission_errors: invalid_gate for malformed or incoherent config/state and unsupported builder mode; invalid_runtime for runtime/type versus captured executable/inert gate mismatch
unchanged_methods: CooperativeIndexJobPump.wakeup(self, job_id: str, /, *, owner_scope: str, worker_id: str, adapter: SourceAdapter, now: str, projection: ProjectionSink | None = None, lease_seconds: int = 60) -> JobStepResult

representation.builder: Capture exact config mode, runtime_enabled and selected_generation. Disabled builds RuntimeStateRecord(DISABLED, None, (), RuntimeHealth(DISABLED, ()), STOPPED, true, false, true, false). Read_only builds RuntimeStateRecord(READ_ONLY, RuntimeGeneration(selected_generation), (), RuntimeHealth(READY, ()), STOPPED, true, false, true, false). Catch every BaseException as fresh invalid_gate from None, then call the constructor with runtime None.
representation.constructor: After exact config/state capture and coherence validation, derive enabled once. Enabled requires exact runtime; non-enabled requires runtime is None. Retain only runtime-or-None, enabled, one lock and lifecycle scalars.
representation.inert_wakeup: After closed and busy lifecycle checks, reject inert before reading or calling runtime. Do not validate request values, acquire a lease or invoke adapter/projection for an inert pump.
representation.preserved_step: For an executable pump preserve exactly one acquire then one run_next outside the lock, exact JobStepResult identity, fixed step_failed boundary, no retry and no retained request or lease.

stop_rule: One bounded correction is allowed only for uir04b_default_off_inert_pump_composition_and_runtime_admission; recurrence releases blocked, triggers reflect and continues another dependency-ready route without a second patch, helper, App path or control-plane expansion.
